Welcome to saber ! How may I help you?

7SABER is a brand developed by the London Institute of Identity (INSTID) and the Tashkent agency GRANDPR, officially launched on June 25, 2021. They offer a product line of Saber Sneakers priced at $86, available in various colors such as Cerulean, Tiffany, Dirty Blue, Sand, Light Green, Light Blue, Olive, Light Brown, Lilac, Turquoise, Orange, Black, and Dark Blue. Sizes range from 41 to 48. For inquiries, you can contact them at +998 99 010-77-77 or via email at shop@7saber.uz. Their address is 10B Beshyogoch Street, 100060, Tashkent, Uzbekistan.
